textbookBox.concept: When we multiply a number by 10 we take that many groups of ten. So 2 × 10 is 2 tens, which is 20, and 8 × 10 is 8 tens, which is 80. Ten tens make one hundred, so 10 × 10 = 100.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: When we multiply a number by 10 we take that many groups of ten. So 2 × 10 is 2 tens, which is 20, and 8 × 10 is 8 tens, which is 80. Ten tens make one hundred, so 10 × 10 = 100.
beats.speakEn: When we multiply a number by 10 we take that many groups of ten. So 2  times  10 is 2 tens, which is 20, and 8  times  10 is 8 tens, which is 80. Ten tens make one hundred, so 10  times  10  equals  100.

beats.en: We can build a times table by splitting an arrangement. For 5 × 15, split the 15 into 10 and 5. Then 5 × 10 = 50 and 5 × 5 = 25, so 5 × 15 = 50 + 25 = 75. The times-15 table goes 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, and so on up to 150.
beats.speakEn: We can build a times table by splitting an arrangement. For 5  times  15, split the 15 into 10 and 5. Then 5  times  10  equals  50 and 5  times  5  equals  25, so 5  times  15  equals  50 + 25  equals  75. The times-15 table goes 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, and so on up to 150.

type: Key Concept: When we multiply a number by 10 we take that many groups of ten.
Rule: We can build a times table by splitting an arrangement.

textbookBox.concept: Another trick is to split an arrangement into two equal groups. Tara has 3 rows of 14 wheels. She splits 14 into 7 and 7. 3 × 7 = 21, so 3 × 14 = 21 + 21, which is double of 21, so 42.

beats.en: Another trick is to split an arrangement into two equal groups. Tara has 3 rows of 14 wheels. She splits 14 into 7 and 7. 3 × 7 = 21, so 3 × 14 = 21 + 21, which is double of 21, so 42.
beats.speakEn: Another trick is to split an arrangement into two equal groups. Tara has 3 rows of 14 wheels. She splits 14 into 7 and 7. 3  times  7  equals  21, so 3  times  14  equals  21 + 21, which is double of 21, so 42.

beats.en: A small bus seats 20 people. How many people sit in 12 buses? We find 12 × 20. We can split 12 into 10 and 2. 10 × 20 = 200 and 2 × 20 = 40, so 200 + 40 = 240. We can also see 20 as 2 tens.
beats.speakEn: A small bus seats 20 people. How many people sit in 12 buses? We find 12  times  20. We can split 12 into 10 and 2. 10  times  20  equals  200 and 2  times  20  equals  40, so 200 + 40  equals  240. We can also see 20 as 2 tens.
